prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Four adult friends aged 27 to 40 walk along a quiet snowy street lit by warm festive string lights, talking and laughing in ordinary wool coats and scarves. Their faces stay visible above the scarves, without exaggerated performance. Use a polished environmental composition, blue-hour ambient light balanced by warm lights, believable snow, and subtle breath. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: a blonde woman with a short fringe, a red-haired woman with round glasses, a dark-skinned clean-shaven man with very short black hair, and a light-skinned man with salt-and-pepper curls. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. Use a WIDE environmental establishing shot with generous space. Keep all four friends, faces and gestures inside the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of the image width; leave the outer left and right areas for street context.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: Photograph from 9 metres away as a distant wide environmental street view, 24mm perspective, not a medium group portrait. All four friends are shown full-length, head to boots, clustered together inside the MIDDLE HALF of image width (horizontal coordinates 25%-75%). Their heads and gestures occupy only the middle 45% of width. LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER contain snowy street and shopfronts without people. Show generous sky/building context and snowy pavement. Preserve native 16:9.
review: Replacement shows all four friends head to boots in the central half of a snowy street. Distinct faces and winter clothes, plausible walking limbs and open-hand gesture; blue-hour light and warm strings are balanced. Large clear side margins support crop. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
